Class Conv2d

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.nn.Conv2d
public final class Conv2d extends Object
Valid (unpadded) 2-D convolution over channel-last maps: index = (y * width + x) * channels + c. Weights are [ky][kx][inC][outC], so one kernel row lines up with a contiguous run of inputs and the inner loop is an axpy over the output channels. Zero inputs are skipped, which makes the first layer almost free on the mostly-empty enemy masks.
